answer.justification: Post-dysenteric urethritis, oligoarthritis (ankle/knee) and conjunctivitis indicate reactive arthritis (Reiter syndrome). A hallmark associated feature is enthesitis, especially tenderness at the Achilles tendon insertion. Erythema chronicum migrans (A) suggests Lyme disease, dactylitis (B) is less characteristic, and an RLQ mass (C) implies inflammatory bowel disease or neoplasm.
